name: add_supplement
description: Add a supplement to the user's own supplement list. Only use an amount the user tells you from their own bottle or book — never suggest one.

dose_label.description: Only what the user said, e.g. '2 capsules'

another_time.description: true if they take the same supplement at a second time of day

with_item.description: Optional: the step it's taken with, as they said it, e.g. 'smoothie' for 'B12 with my smoothie'. Also links a supplement they already have.

name: add_to_shopping_list
description: Add to the user's shopping list exactly as they say it ('add lemons to my list'), and/or the ingredients of their own recipes (recipe_names), and/or everything in this week's plan (this_week: true). Lines are kept as written and sorted by aisle.

items.description: Things to add, one per entry, in their words

recipe_names.description: Their recipes whose ingredients to add

this_week.description: True to add the ingredients of everything planned in the next 7 days

name: cook_along
description: Read one of the user's recipes one step at a time while they cook ('read me the steps', 'cook with me'). start with recipe_name opens cook mode on their screen with the ingredients; then next, repeat, back or stop as they say. Read only the step it returns, word for word, then wait.

name: delete_recipe
description: Delete one of the user's recipes from their Kitchen. Asks for a yes first (needs_confirmation); it can't be brought back.

confirmed.description: Only after they clearly said yes

name: end_program
description: End the program that's running now. Use finished: true when they've finished it; leave it out when they're stopping early. It asks for confirmation first.

confirmed.description: true ONLY after the user clearly said yes to the confirmation question this tool gave you

finished.description: true when the user says they've finished or completed the program, so it's recorded as finished rather than ended early.

name: find_recipe
description: Look in the user's own Kitchen: read one recipe out (recipe_name), find which of THEIR recipes use some ingredients (ingredients), or list them (optionally by kind). Never suggest recipes that aren't theirs.

ingredients.description: e.g. 'potatoes and spinach' for 'what can I make with potatoes and spinach'

name: get_meal_plan
description: What the user has planned: 'what's for dinner tonight?', 'what have I planned this week?'. Only their own plan.

day.description: today, tomorrow, a weekday or YYYY-MM-DD. Default today.

whole_week.description: True for the 7 days from that day

name: get_shopping_list
description: What's still to get on the user's shopping list, by aisle, and how many are ticked.

name: get_today_status
description: Get the real, current state of the user's daily rhythm: every item with whether it's done, plus completed/total counts. Call this before answering any question about today's progress, what's left, or how they're doing — never answer from memory.

name: invite_carer
description: Invite someone (by email) to be the user's carer so they can see the user's progress. Call first WITHOUT confirmed; ask the question it returns; call again with confirmed: true after a clear yes.

confirmed.description: true ONLY after the user clearly said yes to the confirmation question this tool gave you

name: link_recipe
description: Make a step in the user's everyday rhythm open one of their recipes (a 📖 appears on Today), e.g. 'link my green smoothie to my smoothie step'. Leave recipe_name empty to unlink.

item_name.description: The rhythm step, as they said it

name: list_saved_rhythms
description: List the user's saved day templates and multi-day programs, and any program running now.

name: load_day_template
description: Replace the user's current daily rhythm with one of their saved day templates (current items are kept in history). Call first WITHOUT confirmed; ask the question it returns; call again with confirmed: true only after a clear yes.

confirmed.description: true ONLY after the user clearly said yes to the confirmation question this tool gave you

name: log_checkin
description: Save today's check-in from what the user tells you about how they feel (energy, feelings, clarity, symptoms). It shows on their Today screen exactly as if they'd tapped it. Things from their routine ('had my juice') are mark_activity instead.

feelings.description: Any of these that match how they say they feel

mood.description: Their mood in their own words

clarity.description: Mental clarity 1-5: severe fog 1, foggy 2, patchy 3, mostly clear 4, clear 5

name: log_restock
description: Record a supplement restock, e.g. "I bought two more bottles of B12".

name: log_rhythm_item
description: Add an item to the user's daily rhythm, e.g. 'add zinc at 9am'. Call once per item. fixedTime (24-hour HH:MM) sets its daily reminder. If an item with the same name already exists it updates that item's time instead of adding a copy. To tick something off use mark_activity.

fixedTime.description: Optional fixed time as HH:MM 24-hour, e.g. '09:00'

after_item.description: For timing from another step: the name of the step it follows, e.g. 'lemon water'. The reminder comes once they tick that step.

after_minutes.description: With after_item: how many minutes after that step, e.g. 30.

every_minutes.description: With after_item: repeat every N minutes after that step (at least 15), e.g. 90 for a snack every 90 minutes.

until.description: With every_minutes: last time of day, 24-hour HH:MM, e.g. '18:00'.

name: log_water
description: Log glasses of water the user says they've had ('I've had two glasses of water'). remove: true takes some off if they miscounted. Saved in their history; shows on Today and in Progress.

remove.description: True to take that many off

name: mark_activity
description: Mark an item in the user's daily rhythm as done (or undo one). Call this whenever the user says they completed something - e.g. "just had my

item_name.description: The item the user says they did, in their words, e.g. 'celery juice'

action.description: complete to tick it off (default), uncomplete to undo

name: plan_recipe
description: Put one of the user's OWN recipes on a day: 'the potato bake for dinner tonight', 'my liver smoothie tomorrow morning'. It shows on that day's matching step. remove: true takes it off. If it asks which meal, ask them.

recipe_name.description: Their recipe, as they said it

day.description: today, tonight, tomorrow, a weekday (e.g. 'friday') or YYYY-MM-DD. Default today.

remove.description: True to take it off that day

name: remove_rhythm_item
description: Remove an item from the user's daily rhythm (and its reminders). It's kept in their history and can be restored. Call first WITHOUT confirmed; ask the question it returns; call again with confirmed: true only after a clear yes.

confirmed.description: true ONLY after the user clearly said yes to the confirmation question this tool gave you

name: remove_supplement
description: Remove a supplement from the user's list. Call first WITHOUT confirmed; ask; call again with confirmed: true after a clear yes.

confirmed.description: true ONLY after the user clearly said yes to the confirmation question this tool gave you

name: restore_rhythm_item
description: Bring back an item the user removed ('undo', 'put my lemon water back'). With no item_name, restores the most recently removed item.

name: save_day_template
description: Save the user's daily rhythm as it is right now as a named day template they can reload later. Same name again updates it.

name: save_program
description: Save a multi-day program the user describes from their own book (e.g. their 9-day cleanse): its name, how many days, and each item with the days it applies to. If they already have one with that name, it asks whether to update it (replace: true) or save under a new name.

total_days.description: How many days the program runs (2-90)

emoji.description: Optional single emoji for the program

items.description: The program's items as the user dictated them

name.description: Item name as the user said it

from_day.description: First day this item applies (1-based). Defaults to 1.

to_day.description: Last day this item applies. Defaults to the program's last day.

note.description: Optional note, e.g. a page reference the user mentions

time.description: Optional set time for this step, 24-hour HH:MM, e.g. '12:00'. Gives it a reminder.

replace.description: true ONLY when the user chose to update their existing program of the same name. Without it, an existing name is never overwritten.

name: save_recipe
description: Save one of the user's OWN recipes into their Kitchen, sorted from what they said: name, kind, ingredients, steps. Use only their words and amounts; never add or suggest anything. The first call returns a read-back: read it to them and call again with confirmed: true only after they say yes. Never overwrites an existing name.

name.description: Its name as they said it, or a short plain one (e.g. 'Green smoothie')

kind.description: Which section: juice, smoothie, meal, snack, drink or other

ingredients.description: One entry per ingredient, in their words with their amounts

steps.description: Their steps in order, one action each, no numbers

notes.description: Anything else they said (page number, who it's for, tips)

favourite.description: True if they say it's a favourite

confirmed.description: Only after reading it back and hearing yes

name: save_reflection
description: Save a spoken reflection to the user's journal. Use when the user shares how they feel and agrees to save it, in their own words.

text.description: The reflection to save, in the user's own words

name: share_report
description: Email the user's report as a PDF to someone they name (e.g. their GP or a carer). kind 'doctor' = health summary over recent months; 'progress' = their wellness log. Call first WITHOUT confirmed; it returns a question that spells the address back — ask it, and call again with confirmed: true only after a clear yes.

months.description: For kind doctor: how many months, 1-12 (default 3)

confirmed.description: true ONLY after the user clearly said yes to the confirmation question this tool gave you

name: start_program
description: Start one of the user's saved multi-day programs (e.g. their cleanse), today or on a date. Pass name. Optionally pause: everyday items they want paused during it. Or another_round: true to repeat the one that just finished. It asks for confirmation before pausing anything or replacing a running program.

confirmed.description: true ONLY after the user clearly said yes to the confirmation question this tool gave you

pause.description: Names of everyday rhythm items the user wants paused while this program runs. Leave out to keep everything (the default). Their own choice: never suggest what to pause.

another_round.description: true when the user wants to repeat the program that just finished, with the same steps and choices, starting today. name is then not needed.

name: switch_tab
description: Take the user to a place in the app when they ask, or when it would help (e.g. 'where are my supplements', 'I want to log how I feel', 'show my progress'). The app has five tabs: home (Today), kitchen (their own recipes), companion, progress, settings. Optionally pass a section to land on the exact spot.

section.description: Optional spot within the tab. home: rhythm, checkin, supplements. companion: talk, feelings ('How I feel'). progress: streaks, history, reports (incl. GP report), letters (anniversary letters). settings: reminders, voice (companion voice & minutes), profiles, display (dark mode, text size), carers (and caregiver mode), plan (billing, cancelling), preferences (language, units, what the companion remembers), devices (wearables), sources (official Anthony William books, website, podcast, recipes), help (tips, welcome tour), account (sign out, Terms, Privacy, delete account). kitchen: juice, smoothie, meal, snack, drink, other, week (their week plan), shopping (their shopping list).

name: tick_shopping_item
description: Tick an item off the user's shopping list while they shop ('got the celery'). untick: true puts it back.

item.description: The item, as they said it

name: update_preferences
description: Change the user's companion settings: your name (what they call you), and whether the morning check-in and evening reflection prompts appear.

name: update_recipe
description: Change one of the user's recipes: rename, move section, add/remove/replace ingredients or steps, notes, favourite. Replacing or removing asks for a yes first (needs_confirmation).

recipe_name.description: Which recipe, as they said it

ingredients.description: The whole new ingredient list (replaces it)

add_steps.description: Steps to add at the end

steps.description: The whole new list of steps (replaces it)

confirmed.description: Only after they said yes to the change

name: update_rhythm_item
description: Change an item already in the user's daily rhythm: rename it, set or change its reminder time(s), how often, its note or category. E.g. 'move my lemon water to 6', 'remind me about zinc morning and night', 'rename celery juice to celery juice 16oz'.

item_name.description: The item as the user calls it

times.description: Reminder times, 24-hour HH:MM, e.g. ['06:00','20:00']. Empty array removes the time and its reminder.

after_item.description: For timing from another step: the name of the step it follows, e.g. 'lemon water'. The reminder comes once they tick that step.

after_minutes.description: With after_item: how many minutes after that step, e.g. 30.

every_minutes.description: With after_item: repeat every N minutes after that step (at least 15), e.g. 90 for a snack every 90 minutes.

until.description: With every_minutes: last time of day, 24-hour HH:MM, e.g. '18:00'.
